title: Sr. Information Systems Engineer, Infrastructure
description:
**Description**

Synaptics is driving innovation in AI at the Edge, bringing AI closer to end users and transforming how we engage with intelligent connected devices, whether at home, at work, or on the move. As a go-to partner for forward-thinking product innovators, Synaptics powers the future with its cutting-edge Synaptics Astra® AI-Native embedded compute, wireless connectivity, and multimodal sensing solutions. We’re making the digital experience smarter, faster, more intuitive, secure, and seamless. From touch, display, and biometrics to AI-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play.

**Overview**

Synaptics is looking for a Sr. Information Systems Engineer, Infrastructure to join our dynamic and expanding organization. In this role, you will serve as a technical leader within the IT organization, collaborating cross-functionally and with senior leadership to enhance performance and employee efficiency. Your responsibilities will include designing, presenting, troubleshooting, and implementing Microsoft-based infrastructure solutions. This position reports to the Director, IT Operations.

  

**Responsibilities & Competencies**

Job Duties

* Responsible for the day-to-day operations, maintenance, patching, and troubleshooting of physical and virtual servers hosted in data centers, primarily through remote administration
* Support all Windows environments and provide Tier II support services to maintain, manage, upgrade, and optimize services
* Support Microsoft Suite of products to including Office 365, Windows Server, and related cloud technologies
* Provide support on Microsoft 365 best practices and features related to Active Directory
* Provide extensive research, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment background for developing and managing new solutions
* Manage O365 subscriptions, Microsoft licensing, and user management
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Microsoft 365 environments, including Active Directory
* Manage and support Microsoft Outlook and application configurations/protocols for Exchange and Exchange Online
* Develop and maintain technical documentation related to configuration, troubleshoot guides, user guides, FAQs, etc.
* Implement and manage security-related services, procedures, and protocols in accordance with enterprise standards, business requirements, and best practices
* Adhere to enterprise change management guidelines and procedures
* Collaborate with other IT professionals, such as network engineers and security analysts, to ensure seamless integration with existing systems
* Performs root cause analysis troubleshooting and develop options permanent solutions
* Ensures admin access controls, logging, standards, and policies are industry standard
* Monitor and correct critical server issues and create recovery processes for failures and performance bottlenecks

Competencies

* Good understanding of PowerShell to automate systems management, deployment, and implementation of functions and modules
* Strong technical understanding of server, storage, network, and infrastructure administration
* Knowledge of Azure Conditional Access Policies, App Registrations, Enterprise Applications
* Basic knowledge on PowerShell scripting/cmdlets
* Strong customer service attitude and ability to work well with others
* Ability to be flexible and work with a fast paced and dynamic organization
* Collaborative approach to work with teams across organizational and technical domains
* Proactive, self-starter, able to work independently in a fast-paced environment to complete projects on time with minimal guidance
* Well organized with strong attention to detail; proactively ensures work is accurate
* Positive attitude and work ethic; unafraid to ask questions and explore new ideas
* Resourceful and able to solve complex problems through practical use of technology and a solid understanding of infrastructure architecture
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work within a diverse team

**Qualifications** (Requirements)

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering or related field or equivalent
* 5 years of experience with Microsoft technologies with progressive growth
* Track record of assessing business needs, determining appropriate courses of action, and implementing solutions
* Hands on experience with Active Directory Management, O365, AD Domain Migration, Group Policies, permissions, and security
* Experience with Microsoft SCCM/Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, and Teams, OneDrive
* Experience in cloud (AWS) or on-premises server virtualization (VMware), including designing and implementing AWS AD Connector
* Experience working in a hybrid environment (AWS and On-Prem) preferred
* No travel required

*Belief in Diversity*  
*Synaptics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, or genetic information.*

title: Principal Systems Engineer
description:
About the Group:
  
At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we build the future of the cloud for Enterprises as a diverse team of fellow creators and inventors. We act with the speed and attitude of a start-up, with the scale and customer-focus of the leading enterprise software company in the world. AI2 Oerations is one of the core organisations within OCI. We are responsible for providing BM Compute power.

The AI2 Operations org comprises of a family of critical foundational infrastructure services that drive OCI’s hardware lifecycle activities
  
Work with product team on the shared full stack ownership of a collection of services and/or technology areas. Understand the end-to-end configuration, technical dependencies, and overall behavioural characteristics of production services. Responsible for the mitigating critical customer incidents, or deployments or testing required to improve security, performance, availability, and scalability of service. Authority for end-to-end performance and operability. Partner with development teams in meeting SLA to unblock customers. Articulate technical characteristics of services and technology areas and guide Development Teams to engineer and add premier capabilities to the Oracle Cloud service portfolio. Understand and communicate the scale, capacity, security, performance attributes, and requirements of the service and technology stack. Demonstrate clear understanding of automation and orchestration principles. Act as ultimate escalation point for complex or critical issues that have not yet been documented as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Utilise a deep understanding of service topology and their dependencies required to troubleshoot issues and define mitigations. Understand and explain the effect of product architecture decisions on distributed systems. Professional curiosity and a desire to a develop deep understanding of services and technologies.

Responsible for the operation of production environments, including systems, supporting critical business operations. Will perform administration and analysis for multiple production environments and recommend new and novel solutions to improve availability, performance, and supportability. This is an opportunity to bring a combination of deep technical knowledge with administration/analysis knowledge of Oracle’s Cloud Infrastructure to provide support to a wide range of complex production environment problems related to immense growth, scaling, leveraging the cloud, extremely high performance, and high availability requirements.

  

**Qualifications / Experience:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, cloud operations, site reliability engineering, production operations, or a related technical discipline.
* Expert-level Linux administration skills, particularly with Ubuntu and Oracle Linux in large-scale production environments.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues across hardware, operating systems, networking, drivers, firmware, and service dependencies.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems and how compute, networking, storage, and application services interact to affect reliability and customer experience.
* Hands-on experience with automation, scripting, and configuration management using tools such as Python, shell scripting, Ansible, and Terraform.
* Strong knowledge of incident management, service management, root cause analysis, and operational improvement.
* Experience with infrastructure provisioning, configuration, monitoring, maintenance, and host lifecycle management.
* Solid understanding of the OSI model, TCP/IP, HTTP, and structured troubleshooting across multiple infrastructure layers.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as a senior technical escalation point and independently drive complex issues to resolution.
* Demonstrated success using operational metrics—such as mean time to restore service (MTTR), ticket age, incident volume, recurring issue rates, automation coverage, and service level performance—to drive measurable improvements.
* Strong planning and organizational skills, including prioritizing work, managing dependencies, tracking execution, and assessing operational risks.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues, customer impact, risks, and recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.  

**Infrastructure/Networking:**

* Operate and improve Linux-based compute infrastructure to support reliable, scalable AI, GPU, and inference workloads.
* Apply strong networking knowledge across TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, and SSL/TLS to diagnose connectivity and service issues.
* Troubleshoot communication failures between hosts, nodes, and distributed services, identifying dependencies and potential points of failure.
* Use Ansible, Terraform, Python, and shell scripting to standardize infrastructure configuration and automate operational tasks.
* Support datacentre operations, including host provisioning, maintenance, hardware troubleshooting, repair coordination, and decommissioning.
Collaborate with infrastructure and networking teams to improve availability, capacity, configuration consistency, and operational readiness.  

**Incident Management:**

* Lead the technical response and coordination of critical infrastructure incidents, from initial triage through service restoration, recovery validation, and handoff.
* Assess customer and workload impact, clearly distinguishing confirmed issues from symptoms still under investigation.
* Coordinate across the Network Operations Centre (NOC), networking, datacentre operations, GPU and interconnect engineering, hardware repair, and service delivery teams to drive timely resolution.
* Provide calm, clear communication during high-severity incidents, keeping customers and stakeholders informed of impact, progress, risks, and next steps.
* Maintain accurate incident records, including timelines, accountable owners, mitigation actions, decisions, and escalation paths.
* Validate recovery with customers and technical owners before completing incident closure or transitioning to follow-up work.
* Lead root cause analysis and post-incident reviews, ensuring corrective and preventive actions are assigned and tracked to completion.
Use telemetry, operational trends, and support ticket data to identify recurring issues, prioritize repairs, and strengthen incident response.  

**Technical Leadership:**

* Provide hands-on technical leadership for compute and inference infrastructure as a senior individual contributor.
* Guide engineers through complex troubleshooting, infrastructure improvements, and operational decisions.
* Mentor team members, share technical knowledge, and contribute to hiring and onboarding.
* Set high standards for engineering quality, ownership, documentation, and operational discipline.
* Drive the adoption of automation, observability, reliable incident response, and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to architecture and design reviews, balancing reliability, scalability, maintainability, cost, and business priorities.
Lead technical initiatives across teams, aligning stakeholders on priorities, responsibilities, and delivery plans.  

**Engineering and Automation:**

* Develop and maintain automation that improves reliability, reduces repetitive manual work, and accelerates incident diagnosis and recovery.
* Build reusable scripts, operational tools, and workflows using Python, shell scripting, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies.
* Standardize infrastructure provisioning, configuration, validation, maintenance, and recovery procedures.
* Create and maintain clear runbooks and technical documentation to support consistent execution and knowledge sharing.
* Partner with engineering teams to turn recurring operational problems into sustainable engineering improvements.
Support safe infrastructure changes through testing, staged deployment, validation, and rollback planning.  

**Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Engagement:**

* Partner with Product, backend service engineering, datacentre operations, networking, and customer support teams to deliver reliable infrastructure services.
* Serve as a technical escalation point for complex production issues and critical infrastructure decisions.
* Translate customer requirements and operational challenges into clear technical priorities and improvement plans.
* Communicate infrastructure health, service risks, dependencies, and delivery progress to relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate service readiness and operational handoffs, ensuring teams have the monitoring, documentation, and support procedures needed for production.
Collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams to maintain clear ownership and timely execution.  

**Performance Optimization:**

* Benchmark and tune infrastructure to improve performance, reliability, scalability, and resource efficiency.
* Analyze GPU utilization and identify opportunities to improve capacity use and workload efficiency.
* Investigate performance bottlenecks across compute, memory, storage, networking, and service dependencies.
* Improve performance consistency and resource isolation in multi-tenant environments.
* Partner with service and workload owners to diagnose customer performance issues and validate improvements.
Use performance data to recommend configuration changes, capacity adjustments, and engineering priorities.  

**Monitoring and Telemetry:**

* Build and maintain monitoring, dashboards, and telemetry that provide clear visibility into infrastructure health and customer experience.
* Use Prometheus, Grafana, and related tools to track availability, performance, capacity, and service reliability.
* Define actionable alerts and improve alert quality to support early detection and efficient troubleshooting.
* Correlate metrics, logs, events, and support ticket data to identify failures and emerging operational risks.
* Establish and track service level indicators and objectives, partnering with service owners to address reliability gaps.
Improve monitoring coverage and diagnostic information across GPU hosts, networking, hardware, and supporting services.  

**Preferred / Nice to Have:**

* Experience operating large-scale GPU fleets, AI/ML infrastructure, inference platforms, or high-performance computing (HPC) environments.
* Advanced experience with NVIDIA and AMD GPU ecosystems, including GPU diagnostics, performance analysis, and platform troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of high-performance networking technologies such as InfiniBand, RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE), and Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA).
* Experience with Kubernetes, containers, and workload orchestration in production environments.
* Familiarity with CUDA, NCCL, Slurm, or similar AI and HPC technologies.
* Experience building or scaling GPU cloud platforms, AI factories, or large-scale inference infrastructure.
* Experience providing technical leadership in 24×7 production operations with globally distributed stakeholders.
* Experience supporting multi-region infrastructure deployments or working with hyperscalers, cloud providers, or AI-focused technology companies.
* Experience improving operations through AIOps, event correlation, triage automation, alert noise reduction, and standardized runbooks.
* Experience with patching, upgrades, staged rollouts, change management, operational risk assessment, audit readiness, and compliance requirements.

title: System Admin
description:
Astrome Technologies builds wireless communication hardware for both space and terrestrial applications. We’re looking for a self-motivated system administrator who enjoys open-source tooling and wants to keep the infrastructure behind that work reliable, secure, and well documented. If you want to help others and contribute to Astrome’s vision, join us.

**Responsibilities**

* Administer the health of all computing and networking assets, including laptops, desktops, on-premises servers, remote servers, routers, switches, and other networking equipments.
* Maintain high uptime for all servers and services, with monitoring and alerting in place.
* Manage Ubuntu Server deployments and Linux laptops, including provisioning, patching and lifecycle management.
* Support and maintain the CI/CD infrastructure, including GitHub/GitLab and Docker/Podman-based pipelines and runners.
* Administer and back up SQL databases and other production data stores.
* Perform periodic security audits, manage access control, and apply hardening best practices across all systems.
* Maintain secure remote access to all necessary out-of-office services (VPN, SSH, etc.).
* Automate periodic tasks, updates, and provisioning wherever possible (Bash, Python, Ansible or similar).
* Document and keep current the network topology, configurations, and IP/VLAN plans.
* Create, maintain, and regularly test the backup and disaster recovery policy.
* Document your work, covering reasoning, outcomes, and references, so that anyone with reasonable domain knowledge can understand and reproduce it.
* Coordinate with engineering and other teams to support their IT infrastructure needs.
* Coordinate with vendors to procure and repair all IT-related requirements.
* Manage IT infrastructure at the second office, located about 3 km from the main office, which involves occasional travel between the two sites.
* Participate in field deployments of products at customer premises.
* Be available for on-call duty to respond to critical incidents and outages.

**Requirements**  

* Must have 2-3+ years of experience.
* Qualification - BSc, B.E, B.Tech or any other related field.
* A very good understanding of Linux and basics of Networking & Security is a must.
* Knowledge of setting up and deploying apps in AWS, GCP, Azure or DigitalOcean.
* Knowledge of LXC/LXD, Podman or Docker.
* Knowledge on scripting skills in Bash and Python.
* Knowledge of troubleshooting and replacing part of desktops and laptops.
* Basic knowledge of HTML,CSS and JS is an added advantage.
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently with minimal direction from the manager.

title: Embedded Systems Engineer — Edge AI & Sensors
description:
**Job Description**

This role sits at the point where our hardware, our sensors and our AI models meet. A model that hits 92% mIoU in a notebook is worth nothing if the device it runs on drops frames, loses GPS lock, overheats in a Rajasthan summer or produces uncalibrated thermal data. Closing that gap is the job. You will work across our product lines — building the capture stack for dashcam units, standing up Jetson Orin nodes, and integrating thermal and LiDAR sensors. You will work directly with the AI team on what the models need from the hardware, and with the hardware manager on what the hardware can actually deliver. This is a hands-on role in a small team. You will spend time at a bench with a soldering iron and a logic analyser, time in a terminal cross-compiling and profiling inference, and time in the field on a highway shoulder or at a remote installation site figuring out why unit 14 stopped reporting.

**Responsibilities**

* Bring up and configure edge computing devices and embedded Linux systems.
* Set up NVIDIA Jetson and ARM platforms.
* Integrate RGB, thermal, LiDAR, depth, IMU, and GPS sensors.
* Calibrate sensors and synchronize multi-sensor data.
* Deploy, convert, and optimize AI models using ONNX and TensorRT.
* Build and maintain on-device software, inference pipelines, buffering, and GPS tagging.
* Manage cloud uploads, OTA updates, device telemetry, and field deployments.
* Debug field devices and manage power, thermal issues, wiring, calibration, and BOM documentation.

**Required Skills:**

* LiDAR
* SDK Development
* GMSL
* MIPI CSI
* V4L2
* NVM
* eMMC
* Fastboot
* U-Boot
* Device Tree
* BSP Development
* ARM SBC
* NVIDIA Jetson
* Embedded Linux
* Buildroot
* Yocto
* Model Quantization
* TensorRT
* ONNX
* ROS2
* ROS
* PTP
* Kalibr
* OpenCV
* NMEA Parsing
* UART
* SPI
* I2C
* GPS Interfacing
* IMU Interfacing
* Shell Scripting
* Git
* KiCad
* Oscilloscope
* Hardware Debugging
* IP Rating
* Network Resilience
* Power Budgeting
* Balena
* AWS IoT
* OTA Updates
* MQTT
* SQLite
* Multithreading
* Python
* DeepStream SDK
* C++

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years of hands-on experience in embedded Linux, edge AI deployment or sensor systems engineering. Strong candidates with 2 years of genuinely deep work will be preferred over 5 years of shallow exposure.
* Proficient in Python and C++ — enough C++ to work inside an inference pipeline, not just script around one.
* Comfortable on embedded Linux on ARM: JetPack or Yocto/Debian based images, systemd services, device tree basics, cross-compilation, kernel modules and driver troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of hardware interfaces — I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, USB3, MIPI CSI-2, Ethernet — and the ability to debug them with a multimeter, logic analyser or oscilloscope rather than by guessing.
* Practical experience with camera and video pipelines: V4L2, GStreamer, RTSP, encoding and frame timing.
* Experience deploying a trained neural network onto an edge device — ONNX Runtime, TensorRT or equivalent — including quantisation and measured latency benchmarking.
* Git, structured version control habits, and the discipline to document what you built.
* Willingness to travel for field deployments and to work outdoors at installation sites.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior IT Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Requirements**  

The role is responsible for providing **remote Level 4 (L4) support** to field engineers who install, upgrade, and perform hardware refreshes of the Ethos Server Appliance. This includes rapidly analyzing deployment failures — particularly those caused by customer network and infrastructure conditions such as misconfigured ports, DNS, NTP, proxy, and TLS packet-inspection issues — so that customers can be promptly notified of the root cause. The position is embedded within the Engineering organization, where training and on-the-job support are provided.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide remote L4 support to field engineers during Server Appliance installations, upgrades, and hardware refreshes, including data-migration scenarios that run an old and new appliance in parallel. The global Server Appliance L4 deployment support is provided remotely and requires regular support on the weekends as well.
* Rapidly diagnose customer-side network and infrastructure failures — firewall port closures, DNS and NTP misconfiguration, proxy connectivity, and TLS/SSL packet inspection — and help the field support to notify the customer of the identified cause.
* Analyze log files across heterogeneous systems (PowerShell installation logs, Grafana Dashboard logs, Veeam Backup reports, and Kubernetes pod states) to determine root cause.
* Document analysis results in a structured, traceable, and easy-to-understand format, using within the L4 Assistance Requests in SalesForce with clear cause classification and detailed resolution notes.
* Distinguish between product defects, deployment errors, and customer-environment issues, and escalate genuine engineering cases to the engineering defect review board.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by documenting common failure patterns, troubleshooting runbooks, and network-prerequisite checklists to reduce future L4 demand.

Desired Skills and Experience

Strong network troubleshooting at diagnostic depth: TCP/IP, DNS (including forwarders), NTP, routing, proxy behavior, and TLS/SSL certificate trust chains and packet inspection — able to prove which port or record is missing (e.g., using Test-NetConnection or WireShark).

Experience with enterprise firewalls (Palo Alto preferred), including HA pairs, configuration commit/sync, and SSL/TLS service profiles.

Solid IT Systems Engineering background familiar with the Server Appliance technology stack: VMware vSphere/ESXi (incl. PowerCLI and GPU passthrough), Ubuntu Linux, Windows Server, Active Directory, and PKI / certificate management.

Familiarity with Dell server/iDRAC, Dell/PowerVault storage, Veeam Backup & Replication, Parallels RAS/Citrix Virtual Apps, Kubernetes (RKE2), IaaS automation (Ansible, Terraform, PowerShell), and SSO Authentication (KeyCloack, Oauth, OpenID) is an advantage.

Experience analyzing log files and identifying root causes across multiple system types.

Minimum 7 years of IT systems / infrastructure engineering experience, with demonstrated network specialization.

 **Work Experience**  

**Desired Skills and Experience**

* Strong network troubleshooting at diagnostic depth: TCP/IP, DNS (including forwarders), NTP, routing, proxy behavior, and TLS/SSL certificate trust chains and packet inspection — able to prove which port or record is missing (e.g., using Test-NetConnection or WireShark).
* Experience with enterprise firewalls (Palo Alto preferred), including HA pairs, configuration commit/sync, and SSL/TLS service profiles.
* Solid IT Systems Engineering background familiar with the Server Appliance technology stack: VMware vSphere/ESXi (incl. PowerCLI and GPU passthrough), Ubuntu Linux, Windows Server, Active Directory, and PKI / certificate management.
* Familiarity with Dell server/iDRAC, Dell/PowerVault storage, Veeam Backup & Replication, Parallels RAS/Citrix Virtual Apps, Kubernetes (RKE2), IaaS automation (Ansible, Terraform, PowerShell), and SSO Authentication (KeyCloack, Oauth, OpenID) is an advantage.
* Experience analyzing log files and identifying root causes across multiple system types.
* Minimum 7 years of IT systems / infrastructure engineering experience, with demonstrated network specialization.

title: Virtual Infrastructure - Senior Systems Engineer
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Virtualization Team is responsible for designing, deploying, and operating the virtualization layer that underpins FactSet's infrastructure — from traditional vSphere environments across our global data centers to a growing Kubernetes-native virtualization platform that serves as the foundation for our internal developer platform.

As a Senior Systems Engineer on this team, you will manage both our established VMware vSphere estate and help build and operate the next generation of our virtualization infrastructure using KubeVirt and Rancher Harvester. You will work closely with platform engineering, storage, networking, Kubernetes, and application teams to deliver reliable, high-performance infrastructure that supports thousands of workloads worldwide. The team has access to AI tools and actively uses them to accelerate automation development and improve incident response.

RESPONSIBILITIES

* Administer and evolve our KubeVirt and Rancher Harvester hyperconverged infrastructure as part of our internal developer platform
* Design, deploy, and operate vSphere environments across data centers, offices, global POPs, and remote client locations
* Manage VM lifecycle across both traditional and Kubernetes-native virtualization platforms, including live migration, capacity planning, and cluster maintenance
* Collaborate with platform and application teams to define and implement virtualization requirements for new and existing workloads
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve performance and stability issues across vSphere, KubeVirt, and Harvester environments
* Design and maintain distributed storage systems (VSAN, Longhorn) supporting VM and container workloads
* Automate infrastructure lifecycle management using PowerShell, PowerCLI, and Kubernetes-native tooling (Terraform, GitOps/ArgoCD/Flux)
* Leverage AI tools to accelerate automation development, improve runbooks, and enhance incident response workflows
* Create and maintain process documentation to ensure operational efficiency and availability
* Plan and execute capacity expansions across both legacy and cloud-native virtualization stacks
* Participate in a periodic 24x7 on-call rotation. Global follow the sun strategy minimizes non-work hours interruptions.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

* 5+ years of experience with VMware vSphere/ESXi administration
* Foundational understanding of Kubernetes concepts and cluster operations, or strong motivation to develop this expertise
* Experience with PowerShell and PowerCLI scripting and automation
* Strong technical, analytical, and communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize appropriately

CRITICAL SKILLS

* Kubernetes fundamentals: CRDs, operators, RBAC, networking, persistent volumes, and cluster lifecycle management
* Knowledge of VMware technologies: vCenter, vSphere/ESXi, and virtual infrastructure administration for mixed Windows and Linux guest environments
* Experience with KubeVirt or similar VM-on-Kubernetes solutions (libvirt, KVM, QEMU)
* Familiarity with hyperconverged infrastructure platforms, particularly Rancher Harvester
* Understanding of distributed storage systems (Longhorn, Ceph, or similar) including replication, snapshots, and recovery
* Advanced Kubernetes networking: CNI plugins, Multus CNI for multi-network VM configurations, network policies
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and GitOps workflows (Terraform, ArgoCD, Flux)

ADDITIONAL / HIGHLY DESIRED SKILLS

* Knowledge of AWS/GCP public cloud services and hybrid infrastructure patterns
* Experience with container platforms and container runtimes (containerd, Docker)
* Familiarity with observability tooling: Prometheus, Grafana, and log aggregation platforms
* Knowledge of TCP/IP networking, DNS, LAN/WAN, load balancers, and firewalls
* Experience with non-vSphere hypervisors (KVM, Xen) beyond KubeVirt contexts
* Administer and evolve our KubeVirt and Rancher Harvester hyperconverged infrastructure as part of our internal developer platform

EDUCATION

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

**Company Overview:**

FactSet ( NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. title: Lead IT System Admin
description:
**Job Posting Title**


Lead IT System Admin**Job Description Summary**


Responsible for overseeing the daily operations and administration of the IT server infrastructure. Performs a wide variety of technical duties which include, but are not limited to analysis, installation, configuration, modification, documentation, maintenance, problem diagnosis, and repair of all server technology hardware and software. Provides hardware and software technical guidance to core IT administrators and remote sites.**Job Description:**


Act as local IT support, co\-operate with corporate IT to implement standard applications and infrastructure systems in time and with high quality


Maintain IT local applications and infrastructure according to corporate IT strategy, standards, policies and best practices


Work closely with local cross function team supporting Regional/Corporate IT team on site ERP/Other major systems implementation, optimization project support/assistant


Work closely with the Plant operation and ME team to support Regional/Corporate IT on MES system implementation, optimization and supporting


IT support for local users, utilize FreshService System on incidents, problem, and change management


Work closely with Regional/Corp IT team on IT applications or systems update/optimization, be the bridge of local team and corporate IT team on new project launching


Assist finance manager on IT related budget and forecast.


Ensure IT orientation for new associates, regular IT training for end users.


All other duties as assigned

  



**Required Skills and Education**

* Bachelor’s degree major in computer science or relevant majors
* Above 8 years’ experience in Infrastructure support
* Above 2 years’ experience in ERP and MES application support
* In\-deep experience on troubleshooting and end user helpdesk supporting
* Good documentation experience (Visio, Word, etc.)
* People management skill

 **About Dauch:**


Dauch Corporation is a premier Driveline and Metal Forming supplier serving the global automotive industry with a powertrain\-agnostic product portfolio that supports electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. The company is headquartered in Detroit, MI, with operations that span 24 countries and more than 175 locations. Formed through the acquisition of Dowlais Group plc and its subsidiaries \- GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy, Dauch unites deep engineering roots with global manufacturing capabilities and an entrepreneurial spirit to move mobility forward. Visit www.dauch.com to learn more.
